description: This file defines the interface 'FilterFieldExpression' which extends 'FieldExpression' and provides methods for accepting visitors to evaluate filter expressions within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically related to query filters on fields.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a FilterFieldExpressionVisitor to evaluate this filter field expression and returns a result of generic type T.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Overrides the accept method from FieldExpression to accept a FieldExpressionVisitor for evaluating the expression.
